svg.aria-label: Moire interference study of a sphere: two vertical line screens at 4px pitch, the second refracted through the sphere as a thin lens and tilted by the light vector; the beat fringes between the straight and refracted gratings describe the volume.
svg.text: MARK SYSTEM: two vertical line screens, beat interference · pitch 4.0px · screen-1 133 straight verticals (0.42px) · screen-2 133 refracted polylines / 123291 vertices (0.48px) · lens lateral bend max 19.5px = 4.88 periods, M=5.4 rim-clamp 2.7 light-tilt 0.55 · tone n·L 0.00–1.00, L=(-0.55,-0.69,0.46)
